description: Support ticket create: summary and description required rejections both languages agree on (confirm set so both reach them), plus the POST body once confirmed. The dry run pins the quoted summary sentence, the trim the normalize hook applies, and the body echo; severity carries its legal set. A body that will not parse must fail rather than turn into a made-up ticket. The two languages frame the parse failure differently, so the shared assertion is the parser's position marker.
